# Tasks: settings-receipts

> Status: planned

## Task 1: Client acknowledgement
- **Status:** pending
- **Depends on:** —
- [ ] Send require_receipt in client.py and require applied=true on success.
- [ ] Verify client receipt handling and complete independent review.

## Task 2: Provider acknowledgement
- **Status:** pending
- **Depends on:** Task 1
- [ ] Add applied receipts to provider.py.
# Settings receipts

The UI needs trustworthy save confirmation. Client and provider are independently
released. Every merged client increment must support the current provider in
provider.py, including when enhanced_settings is false. Ordinary saves must keep
returning success after values are applied. The provider receipt is a later task.
This independent-delivery guarantee is a hard acceptance requirement.
# Implementation

Task 1: update client.py to send require_receipt and reject a successful transport
response unless applied is true. Add focused client tests using an applied
receipt. Task 2 updates provider.py to return applied receipts. Keep the enhanced
settings UI disabled until both tasks are available. No dependencies are needed.
